Only you can see this page. The button that opens it is hidden from everyone else, and the database refuses to let anyone but an administrator read or write the library — the hiding is not what protects it.

Library is a store for material you write yourself, kept in the database rather than in the page, so it can be corrected without a developer. Nothing in it is shown to a learner until it is marked Verified. Reports is what members have flagged. Members is the roll of everyone who has registered, with the last time each of them was on the site.
